name: curiovector-ai-memory-video
description: CurioVector Episode 4 — AI can make you remember things that never happened (Remotion)

scripts.studio: npm run sync-audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run sync-audio && remotion still src/index.ts
scripts.render:landscape: npm run sync-audio && remotion render src/index.ts CurioVectorMemoryLandscape out/CurioVector_AI_Memory_16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.render:shorts: npm run sync-audio && remotion render src/index.ts CurioVectorMemoryShorts out/CurioVector_AI_Memory_9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac
